mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_search_history (user_id, keyword, search_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT keyword, 1 AS searchCount FROM user_search_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY MAX(update_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
